item.title: What AI bubble? Nvidia posts record $68 billion quarterly revenue and $78 billion forecast, as Jensen Huang cites ‘skyrocketing’ adoption of agents
item.description: Nvidia just released Q4 and FY 2026 results showing another blowout, beating guidance on nearly every metric.

item.title: Jamie Dimon says society should start preparing for AI job displacement: ‘Now’s the time to start thinking about’ it
item.description: Dimon backs AI at JPMorgan but also supports government action to prevent mass layoffs.

item.title: An MIT roboticist who cofounded bankrupt robot vacuum maker iRobot says Elon Musk’s vision of humanoid robot assistants is ‘pure fantasy thinking’
item.description: Rodney Brooks said future “humanoid” robots will have wheels and multiple arms.

item.title: Former Apple exec had lunch with his boss Steve Jobs for 15 years—he says the late founder’s ‘insatiable curiosity’ taught him to never coast on his expertise
item.description: Even after building trillion-dollar products, Steve Jobs never pretended to have all the answers. That’s the lesson that stuck with Jony Ive, Apple’s former chief design officer, who worked alongside the late cofounder for nearly 15 years.

item.title: Hegseth issues an ultimatum to ‘woke AI’ startup Anthropic: Get with military program by Friday or lose $200 million
item.description: The Department of Defense gave the AI company a deadline of Friday to allow the Pentagon to use its AI as it sees fit or face steep penalties.

item.title: In its fight with the Pentagon, Anthropic confronts one of the biggest crises of its five-year existence
item.description: War Secretary Pete Hegseth has threatened to bar defense contractors from using Anthropic's Claude AI models unless the company changes some restrictions in its Pentagon contract.

item.title: Kalshi co-founder levels off-color remark at MrBeast employee caught for insider trading
item.description: Kalshi also fined a political candidate and its cofounder issued an off-color "...and find out" warning to others thinking of insider trading.

item.title: Tech companies are spending an unprecedented $700 billion this year on AI data centers. Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says we’re not anywhere near the peak
item.description: Common sense would seem to suggest the industry's massive spending on AI infrastructure cannot keep doubling every year. Nvidia's boss thinks differently.

item.title: McKinsey studied 61 growth companies that outperformed their peers through COVID, inflation, and labor shocks. Here’s what they all had in common
item.description: Why companies like Walmart, JPMorgan Chase, and Progressive are still investing in growth when uncertainty is highest.

item.title: Exclusive: Startup aiming to break Nvidia’s strangehold on AI data center workloads raises $10.25 million
item.description: Callosum, founded by two Cambridge-trained neuroscientists and inspired in part by the brain, has a system for optimizing workloads across different types of chips
